config.content:
## Meridian Dynamics — FinOps & LLM Observability

Baseline Meridian FinOps + LLM view: stacked bars/areas, gauges, waffles, tag clouds, and dual-axis usage vs cost.

Time range: **2026-04-29 – 2026-08-27 (computed at publish)**. Security→cost (crypto / S3) lives on the [classic](#/view/meridian-finops-llm-observability-classic).

[Open classic](#/view/meridian-finops-llm-observability-classic) · Scenarios: cost leak · ML burn · GenAI ramp · agent-loop · migration · cache-miss.

**Budgets:** [Meridian FinOps AI Assistant](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/agent_builder/chat) · [Observability SLOs](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/slos) · `python -m src.cli agent`.

**ESS billing:** [Billing dashboard](#/view/ess_billing-billingdashboard) · [Credits dashboard](#/view/ess_billing-creditsdashboard).

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-gcp.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(gcp.billing.total) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(azure.billing.pretax_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default, metrics-gcp.billing-default, metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL cost = COALESCE(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost, gcp.billing.total, azure.billing.pretax_cost)
| EVAL provider = data_stream.dataset
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY provider
| SORT cost DESC

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default, metrics-gcp.billing-default, metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL cost = COALESCE(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost, gcp.billing.total, azure.billing.pretax_cost)
| EVAL provider = data_stream.dataset
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), provider
| SORT day

config.title: AWS cost by service — stacked by account

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY account = aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name, service = aws_billing.cur.product.product
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 40

FROM metrics-aws.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == "COST_CENTER"
| STATS cost = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY tag = aws.billing.group_by.COST_CENTER
| SORT cost DESC

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), account = aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend

config.title: EC2 unblended cost vs NetworkIn (dual axis)

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND aws_billing.cur.product.product == "AmazonEC2"
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS network_in = SUM(aws.ec2.metrics.NetworkIn.rate) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS daily = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day DESC
| LIMIT 7
| STATS avg_7d = AVG(daily)
| EVAL projected_30d = avg_7d * 30, min = 0, max = avg_7d * 45, goal = avg_7d * 28

config.content:
## Budget posture

Meridian treats cloud + LLM spend as error budgets. Thresholds come from `config/budgets.yaml` (intentionally tight so the seeded timeline shows breaches).

- **AWS monthly budget:** $150,000 · **AWS daily SLO ceiling:** $5,200
- **Staging daily SLO ceiling:** $150 (cost_leak)
- **checkout-assistant 7d alert floor:** $4.00 (agent-loop)

[Observability SLOs](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/slos) · [Observability Alerts](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/alerts) · [Alerting rules](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/management/insightsAndAlerting/triggersActions/rules)

**Meridian FinOps AI Assistant:** [Open in Agent Builder](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/agent_builder/chat) (agent `meridian-finops-ai-assistant`). Provision: `python -m src.cli agent` · `python -m src.cli budgets`.

config.title: AWS window spend vs monthly budget

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS spend = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost)
| EVAL budget = 150000.0, min = 0, max = budget * 2, goal = budget

config.title: Latest AWS daily vs SLO ceiling

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS daily = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL spend = daily, budget = 5200.0, min = 0, max = budget * 2, goal = budget
| KEEP spend, budget, min, max, goal

config.title: Staging latest day vs SLO ceiling

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name == "meridian-staging"
| STATS daily = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL spend = daily, budget = 150.0, min = 0, max = budget * 8, goal = budget
| KEEP spend, budget, min, max, goal

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai" AND service.name == "checkout-assistant"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS spend = SUM(cost)
| EVAL budget = 4.0, min = 0, max = budget * 3, goal = budget

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens) BY model = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 16

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(cost) BY team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged")
| SORT cost_usd DESC

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), cost_usd = SUM(cost) BY flow = service.name, model = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 40

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), cost_usd = SUM(cost) BY flow = service.name
| SORT tokens DESC

config.title: Tokens by flow over day (stacked area)

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), flow = service.name
| SORT day

config.title: p95 latency by model over day (ms)

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000 BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), model = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT day

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM logs-openai.completions-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(openai.base.usage_tokens) BY user = openai.base.user_id
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 12

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure", calls = COUNT(*)
| EVAL error_rate = errors * 1.0 / calls, min = 0, max = 0.08, goal = 0.01

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000
| EVAL min = 0, max = 8000, goal = 1500

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS calls = COUNT(*) BY outcome = event.outcome

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), cost_usd = SUM(cost) BY flow = service.name
| SORT tokens DESC
